decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution is close to the core aviation security offer and was publicly showcased with UK Home Office use and over 30 government API connections, so the firm has a heavy investment, visible commitment and proven traction to justify persisting.

Post-pandemic demand for travel health requirements has faded and no results are reported, but the API still has its own page and fits the firm's announced aviation integration direction, so management can attribute weak uptake to temporary market conditions and keep it.

The travel and document verification platform sits close to the established document-checking and passenger processing business and remains prominently presented, so sunk development costs and its fit with the strategy favor keeping it.
